Whether the above-baseline soy/softseed crush spread - set by U.S. biofuel policy (the finalized EPA RVO, pending SRE rulings, the 2028/29 "Set 3" rule) and currently amplified by Middle East trade dislocation - holds into 2027 as new industry crush capacity comes online; that spread, not Viterra synergy, is what separates the FY26 $9.25-$9.75 guide from the $7.50-$8.00 the company itself guided six months earlier.
